proposed_widenings.name: class_feature.mechanics.family = persistent_resource_bundle
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is a passive feature that creates a level-scaled resource pool, restores it on rest, and grants multiple subordinate activations rather than being one activation itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This energy is represented by Focus Points. Your Monk level determines the number of points you have ... You start knowing three such features

proposed_widenings.name: granted_subfeature_activations
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants three distinct downstream options with different costs and effects, including no-cost and paid branches.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Flurry of Blows ... Patient Defense ... Step of the Wind

proposed_widenings.name: class_feature.shared_save_dc_formula
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature establishes a reusable save DC formula for other Monk features, which is not an activation effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Some features that use Focus Points require your target to make a saving throw. The save DC equals 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and Proficiency Bonus.

notes: Did not author content JSON because the current surface only supports a single activated class feature with one effect. Encoding this as such would misrepresent the rule.
